source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In the key wizard, resizeWindow delegates to the active SubDialog host and uses window.sizeToContent for a standalone window. The 2024 change waited for section transitions and added a fixed 100 px margin; current revealSection hides other non-overlay sections, reveals the target, and resizes directly. Preserve the current host split when changing visibility. The old height workaround and transition listener are historical, not the current sizing contract. No visual sizing result is claimed. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Resize the OpenPGP wizard through its actual dialog host
